description: Retrieve CWE weaknesses or categories by ID, such as CWE-79, CWE79, or 79. Processes up to 20 distinct IDs within a 24,000-byte response budget and discloses deferred IDs; a view, a CAPEC ID, or an item that is no ID returns in notFound with recovery guidance; only an item holding a control character other than whitespace, or a non-ID item over 150 characters, rejects the whole call. Defaults to summary, consequences, mitigations, and relations; a default section that does not fit the budget is omitted whole and named with its size and a re-call (kind partial). Summary carries recorded alternate terms such as XSS, ordinalities (Primary, Resultant, Indirect), and background details; the notes section, outside the defaults, returns every note MITRE records, such as Relationship, Maintenance, Terminology, and Research Gap notes. Explicit sections remain complete, including one oversized record with disclosure; an empty sections array requests an outline. exampleLanguage, exampleOffset, and exampleLimit select a complete source-ordered page of section examples: with sections omitted, setting any of them to a non-default value adds examples after the defaults, filled last and outlined with its page size and a re-call when it does not fit; explicit sections without examples ignore them, and guidance gives the re-call that adds examples. Categories are organizational entries, not vulnerability root causes.

exampleLanguage.description: Exact source example code language for section examples; discover values through cwe_list_reference topic platforms. With sections omitted, adds examples to the defaults.

exampleLimit.description: Complete examples per entry in section examples; no upper bound beyond the finite source array. With sections omitted, a value other than 3 adds examples to the defaults.

exampleOffset.description: Offset in each entry’s language-filtered examples (section examples). With sections omitted, a value above 0 adds examples to the defaults.

ids.description: One to 200 submitted IDs; up to 20 distinct items are processed within the response budget.

items.description: A CWE ID such as CWE-79 or a positive bare integer. An item that is no CWE ID is reported per item; an item holding a control character other than whitespace, or over 150 characters and no CWE or CAPEC ID, rejects the call.

sections.description: Selected sections; omit for defaults, or pass an empty array for an outline.

name: cwe_get_weakness

deferredIds.description: Distinct items to submit in a later call: canonical IDs, or the collapsed text of an item that is no ID.

items.description: Distinct items to submit in a later call: canonical IDs, or the collapsed text of an item that is no ID.

entries.description: Found projected entries in request order.

affectedResources.description: System resources the weakness affects, such as Memory or File or Directory.

items.description: System resources the weakness affects, such as Memory or File or Directory.

alternateTerms.description: Alternate terms MITRE records for this entry, in source order; absent when none are recorded.

description.description: Source explanation of the term in CommonMark.

availableSections.description: Sections actually present in the catalog entry.

items.description: Sections actually present in the catalog entry.

backgroundDetails.description: Complete background details on the underlying mechanism in CommonMark.

items.description: Complete background details on the underlying mechanism in CommonMark.

nextOffset.description: Offset for the next example page.

blocks.description: All ordered blocks belonging to this example.

items.description: Ordered source prose or code block.

oneOf.description: Complete source code block and its available labels.

nature.description: Open source code nature such as Bad, Good, or Attack.

text.description: Complete code laid out as MITRE displays it: one line per displayed line, each indentation level as 4 spaces.

references.description: Resolved external references this example cites; absent when it cites none.

functionalAreas.description: Functional areas of a product where the weakness occurs.

items.description: Functional areas of a product where the weakness occurs.

kind.description: full: every selected section the entry has, complete. partial: the sections of a default selection that fit the 24,000-byte response budget, complete, with the omitted ones in outline. outline: identity and section sizes only.

members.description: Direct category members in source order.

notes.description: Notes MITRE records for this entry, in source order; absent when none are recorded.

type.description: Source note type such as Relationship, Maintenance, Terminology, or Research Gap.

ordinalities.description: Recorded ordinalities in source order: Primary when the weakness exists independently of others, Resultant when it results from another weakness, and Indirect when it makes other weaknesses easier to introduce or harder to detect.

description.description: Source explanation of the ordinality in CommonMark.

ordinality.description: Source ordinality such as Primary, Resultant, or Indirect.

outline.description: Sections available but not included in this entry, with sizes: every available section of an outline, or the selected sections a partial entry omitted.

items.description: Section not included in this entry, and its size.

sizeInBytes.description: Delivered UTF-8 size of the section on both surfaces: its structuredContent JSON plus its rendered content[] text.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_filter`: The example language is absent from the loaded source vocabulary. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

guidance.description: Call-level guidance: deferred-ID continuation, budget disclosure, and the re-call for parameters the selected sections leave unused.

notFound.description: Per-ID misses; an all-missing batch is success.

id.description: Canonical requested ID, or for invalid_id the submitted item trimmed, with whitespace runs collapsed to one space.

reason.description: Missing record, record of another family or type, or an item that is no catalog ID.

totalCount.description: Distinct submitted identifiers before the batch cap.

truncated.description: Whether the count or response budget deferred identifiers.
